memory_update.text: Add SYY, USFD, PFGC, CHEF, and WEST as public-market mappings for the restaurant food-input/procurement-flexibility node.

Broadline distributors map to procurement scale and substitution flexibility; specialty distributors map to harder-to-substitute premium center-of-plate inputs; coffee/beverage solution providers map to coffee-cost and beverage-menu repricing exposure.

Need a separate pass for protein processors, poultry/beef mix, dairy suppliers, packaging suppliers, and restaurant procurement/software vendors; TSN, HRL, PPC, LW, DAR, FRPT, MKC, INGR, and procurement-tech names require validation before inclusion.
WEST is a below-USD-1B exception and should be monitored for liquidity, leverage, customer concentration, and whether foodservice exposure is large enough to drive the equity story.

node: Food inputs, protein exposure, coffee costs, procurement, and menu flexibility
summary: Expanded the node universe toward foodservice distributors, specialty distributors, and coffee/beverage supply-chain vendors that can benefit from or be exposed to restaurant operators' need for purchasing scale, substitution flexibility, commodity pass-through, and menu-level input management. Current macro evidence supports the node: USDA ERS expects food-away-from-home inflation to remain elevated versus historical norms, beef/cattle supply remains constrained, and ICO data shows coffee remains a material and volatile beverage input. These candidates are research leads only, not recommendations.
